name: InboxFolders
description: Inbound email counts per folder (primary type), handling state and mailbox
technicalDescription: Counts of InboundEmails per primary category (the folder), handlingState and mailboxId, for the folder badges on the inbox page. A mail with several types is counted here under its primary type only; the page adds secondary-folder membership from InboundEmails.categories.

select.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.handlingState, 'לא טופל') <> 'טופל' AND COALESCE(e.category, '') <> 'לא רלוונטי' AND e.dueAt < NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
